🔨 Works Order Tracker

Click to expand

Add live works orders. The due date feeds into the days-of-stock projection. Click a WO tile to see its contents in a popup. Delete individual SKUs as manufacturing completes.

⚠ For non-stock specials only — reference must start with S (Special make), E (EMB) or A (Alterations). For stock items, tick them and use Create works orders for an auto WO number.

Type or paste one SKU per line as code quantity — separated by a space, comma, or tab. E.g. OHHICAPP062803DEN 50

📥 Bulk import works orders

Paste rows from your sheet — one works order per line. Each becomes its own auto-numbered WO (WO-0001, WO-0002…). Due date is set to today + 14 days automatically.

Format per line: start date   code   quantity (tab, comma, or space separated)
e.g. 12/06/2026   OHHICAPP062803DEN   50

✅ Completed Works Orders

Click to expand — searchable production history
Completed WO Ref Code Description Qty made Start Due Action
✓ Code ↕ Description ↕ In stock ↕ Free stock ↕ On SOP ↕ On POP ↕ 3m sales ↕ 6m sales ↕ Daily use ↕ Days stock ↕ Status On WOP ↕ Pipeline ↕ WOP REC ↕ ACT WOP

🔨 WOP REC = recommended make qty for 28 days (4 wks) cover, based on 6-month sales, less stock/On POP/On WOP/Pipeline. Pipeline = units completed but not yet in Sage (counts towards stock until 7am the next day). ACT WOP = your adjusted make qty. Free stock = In stock − On SOP + Pipeline, plus On WOP where a works order is live - shown in blue when it counts a works order, red when short. Days stock = (In stock − On SOP + Pipeline) ÷ daily usage. Click a row for the stock runway.

🧵 Paste fabric stock from Sage

In Fabric Stock.xlsx: Refresh All → select columns A to N, all rows, without the header → Ctrl+C → click below → Ctrl+V.
The sheet is one row per fabric: in stock at HOME, on order, the minimum level and the supplier. The app sets that against what the live works orders need.

✂ Catch up from the cutting sheet

In Cutting Sheet 2026.xlsx: select the rows to square up, columns A to L (Date to Meters - the W/O number is in C, the fabric code in K, the metres in L) → Ctrl+C → click below → Ctrl+V. Then say what those rows are.
Already written off in Sage (the green rows) marks the matching lines Exported, so they can never go into a file from here. Still to write off sets each matching line to the sheet’s metres and ticks it — then press Export ticked (CSV) for the file. The sheet’s fabric code wins where the usage table had another. Rows the app cannot place are listed, never guessed at.

✂ Paste Special Makes data

In Special Makes Live.xlsx: Refresh All → select columns A to N, all rows, without the header → Ctrl+C → click below → Ctrl+V.
No filtering needed — paste the whole sheet. Nothing is created straight away: garment lines land in a review list for you to accept or dismiss one at a time.

💷 Trim costs & quote helper

Type a product code (any size/colour variant works, e.g. OHCJSMOXFORD4801) to see its trims with Sage codes and prices for quoting. Prices come from the Sage trims list; lines marked no code yet are not set up in Sage.

Tibard · Production Capacity Planner
v3 · queue & machine load

Work orders

Live works orders from the buffer app — each SKU on a WO becomes its own routed job. They run first-come-first-served in the order below; drag the grip to push a job up the queue, or set a sewing machine.

Load board

Capacity used per line, per working day, summed from each machine's hours. Turning a machine off lowers this automatically.

quietbusytightfull· % of that day's capacity

Pipeline

Where each order sits today and its forecast finish against the due date.

Cutting

Hours and the queue of work orders per day. Drag a WO chip onto another to change the cutting order.

Sewing

Machines grouped by line, each showing the orders queued on it per day. Drag chips to reorder. Hats run on apron or flex at 85/day.

Finishing

One team — set each person's hours individually for holidays. Stud 1 and Stud 2 each take a person off the tables when running.

Master times

The standard throughput each station runs at. These drive every forecast — change one and the whole plan recalculates. Friday and holidays scale automatically from the hours you set per machine.

📥 Import works order data from the costing app

In the costing app, press Convert to product… on the approved SR, then Download for buffer app — it saves a <CODE>_product.json file. Choose that file here. The Works Order Editor's export (style-edits-….json) is accepted here too: new codes are added and edited stock styles replace what prints for them.

Fabrics, trims with their Sage codes, measurements, manufacturing and finishing steps, times and cutting room detail all come across. Costs stay in the costing app — they are not printed on a works order.
